zechariah.12.p1.b1.text: This is the burden of the word of the LORD concerning Israel.

zechariah.12.p1.b2.text: Behold, I will make Jerusalem a cup of drunkenness to all the surrounding peoples. … I will make Jerusalem a heavy stone for all the peoples; all who would heave it away will be severely injured.

zechariah.12.p1.b3.text: On that day the LORD will defend the people of Jerusalem, so that the weakest among them will be like David …

zechariah.12.p1.b4.text: Then I will pour out on the house of David and on the people of Jerusalem a spirit of grace and prayer, and they will look on Me, the One they have pierced. They will mourn for Him as one mourns for an only child …

zechariah.12.p1.b5.text: On that day the wailing in Jerusalem will be as great as the wailing of Hadad-rimmon in the plain of Megiddo. … The land will mourn, each clan on its own … and all the remaining clans and their wives.
